title: Omit Keys
prompt: A TypeScript serializer needs to remove sensitive fields before logging an object. Write a function that returns a shallow copy without any keys listed in the keys array.

explanation.beginner: Start by identifying what the function receives and what it must return. For Omit Keys, read the story as a simple input-to-output rule: A TypeScript serializer needs to remove sensitive fields before logging an object. Write a function that returns a shallow copy without any keys listed in the keys array. Work through one small example by hand, then write the steps in TypeScript using plain variables before worrying about making the code shorter.
explanation.junior: Treat this as a small pure TypeScript function: avoid mutating inputs unless the prompt explicitly asks for it, return the requested shape exactly, and let the tests drive the edge cases. The main practice area is typescript and objects. Pay attention to edge cases and keep the transformation predictable as the input grows.
